propositions: Jira mutation work is currently scattered across differ, apply wrapper, Cloud ACLI/REST, Jira DC SDK, handlers, and batch orchestration with multiplied retry ownership and no stable failure scope per ticket or per batch.

A new coordinator must model immutable per-ticket TicketPlan values carrying Mutations, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, and disposition, with global caps applied before any remote effect and concrete adapters owning physical replay, timeouts, and SDK retry disablement.

Retry policy must enforce at most three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per logical postcondition, honor provider Retry-After as a lower bound, and defer long waits using retry_not_before rather than early retry.

A new endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible logical outcomes across at least two tickets, with provider scope requiring two endpoint families, while the existing per-pass blast-radius guard is retained unchanged.
Create containment must be label-first (rebar-id:<local_id>) with optional property enrichment second, then safety-abort with known key if local persistence fails.

Live end-to-end validation must pass against both live Jira Cloud (bounded to uniquely-labeled throwaway issues with self-cleaning deletion) and ephemeral live Jira Data Center, exercising coordinator create/binding-lifecycle, commit-unknown recovery, and fuse functionality with real transports and credentials.
